name: Darkened Bank
summary: At Duskwood’s northern edge, Darkened Bank follows the river beside Elwynn Forest. Its shore runs east toward the Redridge Mountains, between the safer north and the forest’s terrors.

sections.title: A Precarious Boundary
sections.body: Darkened Bank follows the river that separates Duskwood from Elwynn Forest. The shore runs from western river bends east toward the stone span leading to the Redridge Mountains. Under Duskwood’s gloomy canopy, it is often the first ground travelers reach when coming south from Elwynn. Near its western tip, a makeshift camp shelters displaced refugees Sven Yorgen and Lars, just beyond the deep woods.

faq.q: Where is the Darkened Bank located?
faq.answer: Darkened Bank follows Duskwood’s northern shore along the river, across from Elwynn Forest. It runs from the far west of the zone east to the bridge crossing into the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Who lives along the Darkened Bank?
faq.answer: A modest refuge camp at the far western edge shelters Sven Yorgen and Lars. Driven from their former lives deeper in the territory, they use the riverbank as a fragile haven while seeking aid against Duskwood’s threats.

faq.q: How do travelers usually reach this area?
aliases: how to get to darkened bank
faq.answer: You can reach the western shore by swimming south across the river from southwestern Elwynn Forest, or by following the southern riverbank west from the Redridge bridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer leaving Elwynn Forest, you can use Darkened Bank as your first stopping ground before heading deeper into Duskwood’s haunted heart.
